correctness.rationale: The graph is the 28 non-Fano-line triples of Z7, adjacent iff disjoint, not the Tutte–Coxeter incidence graph. Independent exact Fano model yields 28 vertices, 42 edges, all distance shells (1,3,6,12,6), diameter4, girth7. K1 is the graph, wedge of 15 S1. At K2 face vector (28,126,112,28); 112 individual free-face elementary collapses leave precisely the original graph, proving inclusion K1→K2 homotopy equivalence. At K3 the 10896 nonempty faces have face vector (28,294,1456,3514,3864,1596,144); an exact deterministic 5404-pair Morse matching is acyclic by full 10896-node oriented Hasse DAG check and has one critical vertex, 87 critical 4-cells. Discrete Morse gives wedge87 S4 integrally. K4 is full simplex by diameter. All real scale thresholds inclusive; no inference merely from rank computations.
